question: Which is an advanced weather satellite of India configured with improved imaging system and atmospheric sounder?
solution:
The correct answer is __**INSAT -3D**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **INSAT -3D** is an advanced weather satellite of India configured with an improved imaging system and atmospheric sounder.
 
• Launched by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), INSAT -3D provides enhanced meteorological observations and data relay capabilities.
 
• The satellite's advanced imaging system includes a 6-channel imager and a 19-channel sounder to capture detailed atmospheric data.
 
• INSAT -3D plays a crucial role in weather forecasting, disaster warning, and search and rescue operations in India.
 
• It significantly contributes to the accuracy and reliability of weather predictions, aiding various sectors such as agriculture, aviation, and maritime operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **INSAT (Indian National Satellite System)** is a series of multipurpose geostationary satellites commissioned by ISRO to cater to telecommunications, broadcasting, meteorology, and search and rescue operations.
 
• INSAT -3D was launched on **26th July 2013** from the Guiana Space Centre in French Guiana.
 
• The satellite was designed to have a mission life of 7 years, providing continuous service for meteorological and environmental monitoring.
 
• INSAT -3D's data is used by the India Meteorological Department (IMD) for weather forecasting and by various disaster management agencies for effective planning and response.
